events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect T-424 worktree state
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git log --oneline -5 && git status --short | head -20 && ls /tmp/t424/ 2>/dev/null | head -30 && git log --oneline origin/main -3 && git merge-base --is-ancestor b3b4f010 HEAD && echo HAS_T270

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-270 commit and stack scripts
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git cat-file -t b3b4f010; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main | head; git branch -a --contains b3b4f010 2>/dev/null | head; ls /tmp/t424/*.sh; cat /tmp/t424/runner.pid /tmp/t424/centre.pid; grep -n "autodraft\|auto-draft\|Draft.*for me\|ask" app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show T-299 autodraft commit
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git show --stat b3b4f010 | head -20; git show b3b4f010 -- app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check autodraft question and stack script
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && grep -rn "ai_autodraft" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.js --include=*.mjs . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head; sed -n 20,32p app/scripts/probe-day2.mjs; cat /tmp/t424/stack.sh | head -60

events.text: Tracing why the Day 2 agent never drafts on the private stack.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Search for autodraft code and runner status
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git grep -n -i -E "autodraft|auto_draft|draft on open|ask.? once" -- cloud app/src | grep -v node_modules | head -15; tail -5 /tmp/t424/runner.log; ps -p 92870,92905 -o pid,lstart,command | cut -c1-150

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check AUTODRAFT key and stack ports
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t424-wt && git grep -n "AUTODRAFT *=" app/src/lib; lsof -nP -iTCP:8941 -sTCP:LISTEN; ps -p 91096 -o pid,lstart,command | cut -c1-160; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep -E ":(894[0-4]|9340|9344) " | awk '{print $2,$9}'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Identify listeners on stack ports
events.input: $ /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep -E ":(894[0-4]) " | awk '{print $2,$9}'; /usr/sbin/lsof -p 91096 -a -d cwd | tail -1; ps eww -p 91096 | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -E "RUNNER_PORT|RUNNER_KEY=" | sed 's/KEY=.*/KEY=set/'
